value.rationale: The source motivation is the economy of acyclic noncontractible complexes. Single-vertex deletion directly tests whether the ten-vertex presentation has homologically dispensable vertices. The result proves none is dispensable for rational acyclicity and gives a structured three-level defect spectrum, while avoiding any claim of global minimality among all complexes.
